tasks.name: In-app notifications with variable-substitution templates
tasks.summary: Create notification_templates and notifications tables; emit in-app notifications on booking confirmed, payment success/failure, and check-in events with template variable substitution.
tasks.details: Template variables: bookingNo, movieTitle, showtime, guestName, roomNo, etc. (CORE-OPS-004). Notification service substitutes variables at creation time. Admin can update templates affecting future messages only. User can mark notifications read. Page 6.
acceptanceCriteria: Booking confirmed event creates notification with correct variable values
Template change affects future notifications, not existing ones
User can mark notifications read; unread count visible in header
steps: Implement TemplateRenderer with Mustache/simple token substitution
Write NotificationService subscriber creating notification rows

tasks.name: File metadata storage with type/size validation and object-storage upload
tasks.summary: Store file metadata (originalFilename, storageKey, MIME, size, domain, entityId, uploadedBy) separately from object storage; validate file type and size before accepting upload.
tasks.details: file_metadata table referenced by movie posters, hotel images, PDFs (CORE-OPS-005 to CORE-OPS-008). Movie/hotel images accept allowed image MIME types; PDFs accepted for specific document fields. Size limit configurable per file category. Files listable and downloadable by permission. Return 422 with reason on invalid upload. Page 7.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload with disallowed MIME type returns 422 validation error
Upload exceeding size limit returns 422 with size constraint message
Uploaded file metadata queryable by domain and entityId
Files downloadable by users with appropriate permission
steps: Implement FileValidationService checking MIME whitelist and size cap
Write POST /files/upload multipart endpoint storing to object storage and inserting metadata
Integrate with movie poster and hotel image upload flows
